thread:
Evelyn Park: Quick sync — we want to run a micro A/B on new invoice line item 'Priority Processing' (PP) next week. Need decisions on grandfathering and alerting.
Evelyn Park: Variant A = add PP as an explicit invoice line at $0.005/req. Variant B = fold PP into a slightly higher per-token rate for a trial cohort.
Samir Khan: How many users in the micro cohort? and do we exclude customers with negotiated SOWs?
Olivia Reed: Legal flagged negotiated SOWs. Exempt those. Also partner-sourced accounts need partner ops consent. :warning:
Evelyn Park: Proposed micro cohort = 3% of monthly active self-serve accounts, 72h window. Exempt enterprise + marketplace. Notify via in-app banner + emails.
billing-bot: Preview export available: /exports/pricing/micro-ab-2015681234.csv (250 rows)
Samir Khan: For grandfathering, instead of immediate opt-out, what about auto-credit for first billing cycle and an explicit 14-day notice before permanent change?
Evelyn Park: I like that. Auto-credit first cycle then 14-day notice. If customer opts out within 14 days revert billing and record opt-out tag.
Olivia Reed: Add contract exception flag: contract_protection=true. Ops: please add 'pp_exempt' tag to those accounts.
Samir Khan: I'll run contract query tomorrow and DM list. Also need to confirm metrics: checkout for rollback — support ticket delta >0.3% OR churn signal >0.05%.
Evelyn Park: Rollback thresholds noted. Who owns marketing copy and the billing note on invoices?
Olivia Reed: I'll own legal review. Samir, can you draft the short invoice note? Something like: "Priority Processing applied as part of trial; credit issued on first invoice if applicable." Keep it plain.
Samir Khan: Will do. Ops question — should we show the new line item label or aggregate it? I vote separate line for transparency.
Evelyn Park: Separate line item for the micro cohort. Good for analysis.
billing-bot: Generated sample invoice template: /templates/invoice/pp-micro-2026.pdf
Olivia Reed: Timeline gap — need signoff from finance lead by Fri 5pm to launch Mon. Evelyn pls confirm owners and I'll queue legal review.
Evelyn Park: Owners: Samir (contracts + billing calc), Olivia (legal + copy), Ops (tagging + rollout flag), Me (experiment owner + comms). I'll post the email draft in ~30m.
Samir Khan: Noted. I'll aim to deliver contract exemptions by Thu EOD.
Olivia Reed: If partner ops raises concerns, we hold marketplace accounts out of experiment indefinitely.
Evelyn Park: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll update the experiment sheet and ping again when the cohort is seeded. :white_check_mark:
